attchmntText: LEEL Electricals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: LEEL Electricals Limited approved its standalone unaudited financial results for the half-year ended 30 September 2026 during a Board Meeting held on 12 November 2026. The company reported a profit before tax of 177.98 lakhs for the six-month period, compared to 50.58 lakhs in the corresponding previous period. Revenue from operations stood at 715.33 lakhs for the half-year. The statutory auditors, Vivek Mittal and Associates, issued a limited review report stating that nothing came to their attention indicating material misstatements. The report noted that the National Company Law Tribunal initiated liquidation proceedings against the company in 2021 and approved the sale of the company as a going concern to Krishna Ventures Limited in 2024. The sale certificate was issued on 12 June 2024.

attchmntText: LEEL Electricals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Intimation under Regulation 76 of SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulation, 2018 for the period ended 30.09.2026'.
